This repository is a hardware project whose design record lives in hw/. Use the cad plugin's single-part flow to add one part to it.

Part: PN LBP-0001, rev X1, title "Lamp base plate", process cnc, material aluminium 6061-T6, make_buy make.
Kernel: CadQuery 2.8.
Geometry: a square plate 80 mm × 80 mm × 5 mm with sharp corners. Four Ø4.5 mm through clearance holes for M4 screws on a 64 mm square pattern centred on the plate, and one Ø8.5 mm through cable hole at the plate centre. No other features.

Deliver hw/parts/LBP-0001/part.yaml and hw/parts/LBP-0001/model.py, add the part's row to hw/bom.csv, keep the design record valid, and build the part with the cad plugin's model build so hw/versions/latest.json names its STEP AP242.

gate_answers.reply: Approved. Commit batch and continue through to the exported STEP without further questions.
